capabilities: Create kanban boards stored as plain Markdown files
Drag cards to reorder them or move them between columns
Filter cards by priority, due date, tag and assignee
Attach and preview images on cards
Toggle between board and Markdown source views
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes troubleshooting for horizontal mouse scrolling and explains the exact Markdown marker syntax (priority, date, assignee, amount, tags).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in kanban view, and task lists in plain Markdown files are hard to manage as a visual board.
summary: Kanban board plugin where each ## heading is a column and each task a card, stored as plain Markdown with priorities, dates, assignees, tags and drag-and-drop.
